items.raw_excerpt: Discover which Mexico City neighborhoods are least affected by earthquakes, and why volcanic soil gives southern areas a natural advantage.

items.raw_excerpt: Anyone living in Norway knows how much locals love a Grandiosa, which is jokingly dubbed the unofficial national dish. If you’ve adopted this tradition yourself, we’ve got some bad news for you.
items.summary_en: Norway has ordered a recall of about 500,000 frozen Grandiosa pizzas because of a health worry. Many people in Norway eat this pizza almost every week. It is even jokingly called the country's unofficial national dish.

items.raw_excerpt: Data provided to CBC News from the territorial health department suggests the Yukon government is still struggling to staff rural health centres across the territory.
items.summary_en: A CBC analysis found that some small rural health centres in Yukon had no nurse on duty for 214 days during one year. The numbers came from data the territorial health department gave to CBC News. The Yukon government says it is still struggling to staff these tiny clinics.

items.title_en: Yukon rural health centres had no nurse for 214 days in one year

items.raw_excerpt: Walk into almost any café in Lisbon or Porto on a Monday morning and you'll hear it: a table of men and women dissecting Saturday's Liga Portugal fixture as if they'd watched it with a notepad. Who pressed well in the first half, where the defensive line was exposed, what the result says about next week's away trip. This isn't the behaviour of a hardcore minority. In Portugal, reading the game this closely — and forecasting what comes next — is simply how football is done.
items.summary_en: In Portugal, people read football matches closely and predict what will happen next. Many fans keep notes while watching games. This habit is normal for almost everyone, not just hard-core fans.

items.title_en: How Portugal Studies Football Like a Science

items.title_original: Portugal's Football Prediction Culture Runs Deeper Than Passion

items.raw_excerpt: On the Portuguese Riviera, roughly 24 kilometres west of Lisbon, a neoclassical building faces the Atlantic with the quiet confidence of a place that knows exactly what it is. Casino Estoril has been many things across its long life: a glamorous escape, a wartime crossroads, and, if legend holds, the seed of literature's most famous spy thriller. Few venues anywhere in Europe carry quite this accumulation of history.
items.summary_en: Casino Estoril sits by the sea, about 24 km west of Lisbon. Over the years it has been a glamorous resort, a stop for people in wartime, and a place linked to spy stories. Its long and colorful past makes it one of the most talked about old buildings in Portugal.
items.summary_ko: 카지노 에스토릴은 리시본에서 서쪽으로 약 24킬로미터 떨어진 바닷가에 서 있는 카지노다. 지난 여러 시기에 화려한 휴양지이자 전쟁 시점의 기착지였고, 지금은 여러 스파이 이야기와 엮여 scenic으로 알려져 있다. 오랜 세월 쌓아 온 이야기가 많아 포르투갈에서 이름이 널리 알려진 건물 중 하나다.
items.title_en: Casino Estoril: The Old Casino with Spy Stories
items.title_ko: 카지노 에스토릴: 스파이 이야기가 남은 오래된 카지노
items.title_original: Casino Estoril: History, Spies, and the Legend of Portugal's Most Storied Casino
